scope: Exact-source independent review and bounded semantic/budget differential; no global handoff or performance claim
static_findings: SourceMapValidator stores only a private immutable SourceUnit slice and an optional complete FileId lookup; SourceUnit contains plain IDs and Strings, so the borrow prevents source mutation while the index lives.
Construction performs no validation or work charge. Expand invokes validate at its unchanged position after e.diagnostics, so earlier source errors keep priority.
Cold scan charges exactly one before each insertion/duplicate check; all failing scans return before publishing the table.
Warm scan is reachable only after a complete unique-source scan and charges the full sources.len each time. Each call rechecks both max_nodes conditions and creates fresh remaining/target state.

Entry identity, parent, target uniqueness, origin, related, and generated-span checks remain in the original order. Empty maps still validate and pay for all sources; an empty map with no sources remains valid without a new module_id constraint.
Standalone SourceMap::validate retains its signature and uses a temporary validator. No validation capability, remaining budget, map outcome, or cross-request state is cached.

independent_validation.baseline_commit_binding: Author baseline receipt at exact implementation commit; rlib bytes independently checked before use
covered: six source sets including empty/unique/early and late duplicates
four initial states: valid warm, entry-error warm, source budget failure, node budget failure
node and work limits including zero and usize::MAX
identity error before malformed origin; parent error; duplicate target before absent origin
same target across separate map module IDs
lower-budget failure after cached-source success then fresh N success

author_controls_independently_recompiled.expand_boundary: N=352, N-1=351, fresh N with complete Core/source-map fingerprint

limitations: Finite deterministic control set; static reasoning is required for the general immutable-source argument.
Frozen baseline and candidate rlibs were reused read-only to avoid another Cargo build and target contention; their hashes and exact commands are recorded.
No workspace-wide tests, native program tests, runtime benchmark, or compilation-speed score was performed by this review.
